data.name: Nusayb
data.gender_notes: Nusayb is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘An-Nasaih’ which means ‘the helper’ or ‘the supporter’. This name is mentioned in the Quran as a companion of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and was known for his bravery and loyalty. The name Nusayb carries the meaning “Helper, Supporter” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nusayb usually hope their child will grow to embody helper, supporter and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes support and assistance, reflecting the qualities of a true friend and companion.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nusayb total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: The name Nusayb is often associated with coming from the noble Sahabi (companion) Nusayb ibn Masud Al-Ansari (RA). He was known for his deep faith, courage, generosity, and loyalty towards the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh), and his role in battles such as the Battle of Uhud and the Battle of Hunayn. As a result, his name has become a precious identity for many Muslims, representing resilience, courage, and unwavering loyalty.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Nusayb holds significant spiritual importance as it signifies the role of a supporter and helper towards one's faith and loved ones. In Islamic teachings, it is emphasized to support and help one another in fulfilling the religious obligations and spreading goodness. Moreover, the name Nusayb serves as a reminder of the unwavering loyalty and devotion of the early Muslims towards the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh), guiding us to strive towards similar qualities in our own lives.
